DLF — wayfinding systems (2017).

A signage program for DLF developments, explored as a family of material options around one wayfinding logic: directional and floor-identity signs, restroom pictograms, freestanding totems, copper numerals on slate, and embossed-stone plates. Same system, eleven materials.

Signage & wayfinding — Anirudh Kapoor. A·15.
